parsed.explanation: The worst documented feature is Tier-2 state targeting: police explicitly detain, prosecute, imprison and extort trans women as well as gay men, with forced examinations amounting to torture and impunity for ill-treatment — a statute shown in use, not a dead letter, so sexuality law here does reach trans people as a lever. Official hostility is on record (2023 constitution omits sexual orientation; proposed 'propaganda' bill), LGBTI groups cannot register, and no working remedy is documented, so functioning institutions are liability, not recourse. Lacking any documented presentation offence, border/document friction, facility rule, custody-placement rule or trans-specific killing data, this sits above the 0.15 severe anchors but below the 0.25 profiles that add universal institutional exposure. Border, facilities and care are open questions, given no credit either way.
